reports.title: Greif Reports Fourth Quarter and Fiscal 2026 Results

guidance.heading: Company Outlook
section: Our markets have now experienced a multi-year period of industrial contraction, and we have not identified any compelling demand inflection on the horizon. While we believe we are well positioned for an eventual recovery of the industrial economy, at this time we believe it is appropriate to continue to provide only low-end guidance based on the continuing demand trends reflected in the past year, current price/cost factors, and other identifiable discrete items.
